topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I shouldn’t have let the lads park on yer drive, not when the lord’s men be watchin’ so close. Tought it be safe, what harm could a bit of shade do, but looks like the lord’s got his eye sharpened for any scrap. Pray the saints, I know the toll it brings. The soil ain’t forgiving and neither are the debts. Yer kin must be as cross as the winter storms. I’ll do what I can, help with the labor, ease the burden. The earth gives and the earth takes, but I should’ve known better.
